results.title: Kubernetes cluster control assessment
results.description: Automated assessment of the k8s-prod cluster against selected NIST SP 800-53 controls.

observations.title: AC-2 — Account Management
observations.description: 3 of 7 cluster-admin ClusterRoleBindings map to human accounts that can authenticate to the API server without MFA. The IdP does not enforce MFA for the kubernetes audience.

observations.title: AU-2 — Event Logging
observations.description: kube-apiserver is started without --audit-policy-file; no audit backend is configured, so API requests are not recorded.

observations.title: SC-8 — Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
observations.description: etcd peer traffic is not encrypted: --peer-auto-tls is false and no --peer-cert-file/--peer-key-file are set on 2 of 3 control-plane nodes.

observations.title: AC-3 — Access Enforcement
observations.description: RBAC is enabled (--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC) and no wildcard cluster-admin bindings to system:authenticated were found.

observations.title: CM-6 — Configuration Settings
observations.description: Pod Security Admission enforces the 'restricted' standard on all non-system namespaces.
